notes: Original research article (Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 2026), not a review. record.json is_retracted is false and the text contains no retraction notice. duplicate_data not applied: the paper cites its earlier work (ref 7) for the pristine DACA pore structure, but does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before, and the densified DIW, in situDIW and pressed-pellet isotherms are new. Uptake is measured by Sieverts volumetry at 77 K and 298 K, 0-100 bar, on carbon aerogels; the paper reports total (not excess) values converted from measured excess.
